name: Tegome ni Sareru Kyuunin no Otome
original_name: 手籠めにされる九人の堕女
source:
The stage is set for an outrageous story of nine young ladies' sexual corruption.

Masato, born a twin brother, has been forced to live a hard life under the law.

Resentful of his long-absent brother, Masato plots to ruin the brother's life by impersonating him during his long absence, violating the village girls as he pleases, breaking off his marriage proposal with his wife, and then framing him for all his crimes.

[translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ012324.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
九名少女遭受荒唐性堕落的故事就此展开。双胞胎之一的正人被法律逼入艰难生活。他怨恨长期不在身边的兄弟，决定在对方缺席期间冒充兄弟，随意侵犯村中女孩，解除与妻子的婚约，再把所有罪行嫁祸给兄弟。
